text: Today I want to show how ARIANNA helps manufacturers operationalize product security. The focus is on HBOM and SBOM creation, continuous monitoring, and vulnerability management in one workflow.

title: CRA requires continuous vulnerability management across the full product life...

name: Google Shape;70;p2
text:
CRA requires continuous vulnerability management across the full product lifecycle.
Manufacturers must maintain SBOMs, monitor vulnerabilities, assess risk, and address findings.
Many organizations have some of the building blocks, but not an operational process that scales.
textPreview: CRA requires continuous vulnerability management across the full product lifecycle. | Manufacturers must maintain SBOMs, monitor vulnerab...

text: The challenge is not only understanding CRA requirements, but making them work in daily operations. Many companies have parts of the puzzle, but not a scalable end-to-end process.

title: Connected products combine hardware and software and often remain in the fiel...

name: Google Shape;70;p2
text:
Connected products combine hardware and software and often remain in the field for years.
Manual vulnerability tracking does not scale in that environment.
ARIANNA brings HBOM + SBOM visibility, monitoring, prioritization, and reporting into one platform.
textPreview: Connected products combine hardware and software and often remain in the field for years. | Manual vulnerability tracking does not scale ...

text: Connected products are different from classic IT systems. They combine hardware and software, stay in the field for years, and create a vulnerability management challenge that manual processes simply cannot handle.

title: A connected device can contain thousands of known vulnerabilities.

name: Google Shape;70;p2
text:
A connected device can contain thousands of known vulnerabilities.
CVSS-only prioritization can leave teams with hundreds of issues to review.
ARIANNA prioritizes based on exploitability and device context, reducing the focus to the vulnerabilities that matter most.
textPreview: A connected device can contain thousands of known vulnerabilities. | CVSS-only prioritization can leave teams with hundreds of issues to ...

name: Tekstvak 1
text: CVSS measures severity. ARIANNA prioritizes risk.
textPreview: CVSS measures severity. ARIANNA prioritizes risk.

text: This is the core problem we solve. A device can contain thousands of known vulnerabilities, but teams do not need thousands of actions. They need a short, relevant list of what actually matters.

title: ARIANNA helps device manufacturers run an efficient vulnerability management ...

name: Google Shape;70;p2
text:
ARIANNA helps device manufacturers run an efficient vulnerability management process.
Build and maintain the device model (HBOM + SBOM)
Continuously monitor new vulnerabilities
Prioritize based on real exploitability and device context
Export reports for customers, internal teams, and regulators
textPreview: ARIANNA helps device manufacturers run an efficient vulnerability management process. | Build and maintain the device model (HBOM + SBOM)...

text: ARIANNA is designed to make vulnerability management operational. It starts from the device model, continuously monitors new vulnerabilities, prioritizes based on real risk, and supports reporting to all relevant stakeholders.

name: Google Shape;83;p4
text:
Hardware Components
MCUs | MPUs | Memories
WiFi, BLE, radio modules | Secure Elements | TPM
Vulnerability management for devices is incomplete without the hardware model.
Hardware components manage critical assets.
Hardware components have vulnerabilities.
They are not exposed to attackers in the same way as software.
The hardware model helps exclude non-reachable software vulnerabilities.

name: Google Shape;84;p4
text: Smart devices are not just software
textPreview: Smart devices are not just software

text: In smart connected products, hardware matters just as much as software. If you do not model the hardware context, you miss critical assets, exposure assumptions, and important filtering logic.

title: The user identifies the main hardware building blocks of the device.

name: Google Shape;116;p7
text:
The user identifies the main hardware building blocks of the device.
Each hardware building block is modeled as a Processing Unit (PU).
Examples include MCUs, MPUs, Secure Elements, memories, and WiFi/BLE modules.
For each PU, ARIANNA derives the HBOM from the validated hardware part number.
textPreview: The user identifies the main hardware building blocks of the device. | Each hardware building block is modeled as a Processing Unit (PU)....

text: The first step is to model the hardware building blocks of the device. In ARIANNA, each of these is represented as a processing unit, and that creates the HBOM foundation.

title: For each Processing Unit (PU), ARIANNA supports the creation of the SBOM.

name: Google Shape;132;p8
text:
For each Processing Unit (PU), ARIANNA supports the creation of the SBOM.
A PU SBOM can combine multiple SBOMs from different software layers.
For MPUs this can include the OS plus customer applications.
For MCUs this can include the bootloader plus application firmware.
The final device SBOM preserves that structure for clearer vulnerability analysis.
textPreview: For each Processing Unit (PU), ARIANNA supports the creation of the SBOM. | A PU SBOM can combine multiple SBOMs from different software ...

text: For each processing unit, ARIANNA supports the creation of the relevant SBOMs. This is important because embedded devices usually contain multiple software layers that need to be analyzed separately but understood together.

title: The device model evolves over the product lifecycle.

name: Google Shape;151;p9
text:
The device model evolves over the product lifecycle.
HBOM usually remains stable, while SBOM changes with new software and firmware releases.
Each new model version can introduce new vulnerabilities and automatically close others when affected components are updated or removed.
textPreview: The device model evolves over the product lifecycle. | HBOM usually remains stable, while SBOM changes with new software and firmware rel...

text: The device model is not static. HBOM is usually stable, but SBOM evolves with each release, and that directly affects which vulnerabilities are identified, remain open, or can be closed.

title: ARIANNA identifies new vulnerabilities daily for every monitored device based...

name: Google Shape;164;p11
text:
ARIANNA identifies new vulnerabilities daily for every monitored device based on its device model.
It uses an internal mapping between hardware/software components and known vulnerabilities.
Public sources such as NVD, CVE.org, GitHub Advisories, and EUVD are monitored continuously.
Findings are enriched with KEV status, EPSS, exploit maturity, and CWE information to support better prioritization.
textPreview: ARIANNA identifies new vulnerabilities daily for every monitored device based on its device model. | It uses an internal mapping between ...

text: Once the device model exists, ARIANNA continuously monitors new vulnerabilities against it. The goal is not just detection, but detection enriched with the information needed for meaningful prioritization.

title: CVSS is useful, but severity alone is not enough for prioritization.

name: Google Shape;236;p15
text:
CVSS is useful, but severity alone is not enough for prioritization.
Context matters: a vulnerability in a non-exposed component is very different from the same vulnerability in an internet-facing device.
Exploitability matters more than volume.
This is why device-specific context is essential for effective vulnerability management.
textPreview: CVSS is useful, but severity alone is not enough for prioritization. | Context matters: a vulnerability in a non-exposed component is ver...

text: Traditional vulnerability management relies heavily on CVSS, but severity alone does not tell us what matters most for a specific device. Device context and exploitability are what make prioritization actionable.

title: ARIANNA includes a configurable pre-triage engine to reduce review workload.

name: Google Shape;243;p16
text:
ARIANNA includes a configurable pre-triage engine to reduce review workload.
It creates a focused queue for the vulnerabilities that need immediate analyst attention.
Lower-priority items remain visible and traceable without consuming the same level of effort.
This helps teams scale triage while keeping final decisions in human hands.
textPreview: ARIANNA includes a configurable pre-triage engine to reduce review workload. | It creates a focused queue for the vulnerabilities that ne...

text: This is where ARIANNA reduces workload. Instead of forcing teams to review everything with the same intensity, it creates a focused triage queue so analysts spend time where it matters most.

text:

textPreview: | Prioritization based on Severity | CVSS Score > 7.0 (Critical & High) | 834 vulnerabilities to triage ASAP (1% + 29.1%) |  | Prioritiza...

text: This example shows the practical effect. Without context-based prioritization, teams face hundreds of issues. With ARIANNA's approach, the workload is narrowed down to a very small set of high-value actions.

title: ARIANNA KEV focuses on vulnerabilities with evidence of real exploitation.

name: Google Shape;312;p21
text:
ARIANNA KEV focuses on vulnerabilities with evidence of real exploitation.
It includes CISA KEV entries.
It also adds proof-of-exploitation signals from EUVD and verified or weaponized exploits detected by ARIANNA.
This gives broader and faster coverage than relying on CISA KEV alone.
Result: faster prioritization and faster remediation.
textPreview: ARIANNA KEV focuses on vulnerabilities with evidence of real exploitation. | It includes CISA KEV entries. | It also adds proof-of-exploi...

text: One differentiator is ARIANNA KEV. We do not rely only on public KEV lists, but enrich them with additional exploitation evidence to accelerate prioritization and remediation.

title: Export SBOM and HBOM in standard formats such as CycloneDX and SPDX.

name: Google Shape;325;p23
text:
Export SBOM and HBOM in standard formats such as CycloneDX and SPDX.
Support NTIA minimum requirements.
Exclude selected components when needed.
Export vulnerability reports on demand in PDF or VEX format.
Generate automatic monthly PDF reports with a full audit trail of actions and status changes.
textPreview: Export SBOM and HBOM in standard formats such as CycloneDX and SPDX. | Support NTIA minimum requirements. | Exclude selected components w...

text: ARIANNA also turns the process into something auditable and shareable. SBOMs, HBOMs, and vulnerability reports can be exported in standard formats for customers, internal teams, and regulators.

name: Google Shape;355;p26
text:
Different teams can manage their own projects in ARIANNA while sharing visibility where needed.
A system-level team can reuse vulnerability decisions already made by component teams.
That reduces duplicate triage effort and improves consistency across products and organizations.
textPreview: Different teams can manage their own projects in ARIANNA while sharing visibility where needed. | A system-level team can reuse vulnerabi...

text: This is important in real organizations: multiple teams work on related products and components. ARIANNA allows them to reuse visibility and decisions, reducing duplicated effort and improving consistency.

The high-priority vulnerability view
The exported final report

text: In the demo, I will show one connected device with multiple processing units and two model versions. We will look at the delta between versions, the resulting vulnerability changes, and the final prioritized output.

The key message is that ARIANNA helps transform vulnerability management from a compliance burden into an operational process. The natural next step is to onboard one device and validate the workflow in practice.
